registration.body: The registration desk is open all day. Got a question, need help, or have a medical issue? Stop by — our volunteers are happy to help. For a real medical emergency, call 112.

photoWall.body: Capture a memory at our selfie wall! Tag your photo with #ExpertsLiveNL and share it online.

garderobe.body: The cloakroom is free to use during the event. Please note: it is unattended — use at your own risk.

toilets.body: Restrooms are available on every floor at various locations. Follow the signs.

lift.body: The elevator is on the left side of the building and gives access to halls 3–10 on the first floor. Need assistance? Ask at the registration desk.

food.body: Coffee, tea, and soft drinks are available all day at the catering points. Lunch is served between 12:00 and 13:00; the networking drinks start at 17:35.

dietary.body: Got dietary needs or allergies? These dedicated counters serve your meals. Can't figure it out? Ask anyone from the organisation for help.

stairs.body: The staircase leads to the first floor (halls 3–10). Prefer the lift? It's on the left side of the building.

askTheExperts.body: Drop in with your questions — speakers and other experts are available throughout the day for 1-on-1 conversations about various Microsoft topics. No appointment needed.

focusBooths.body: A few quiet rooms where you can get some uninterrupted work done — or just decompress between sessions.

gameArea.body: Games and good vibes — including Nintendo Switch 2 with Mario Kart. Brought to you by Experts Inside.

lounge.body: Comfy couches and chairs where you can take a break or catch up with your fellow Experts.

radio.body: This is where Experts Live Radio broadcasts from. Drop by, tune in, wave at the host. Stream live at radio.expertslive.nl.

zaal12.body: Hall 12 is a quiet workspace. Chairs, desks, and solid WiFi — perfect for getting some work done or taking a call between sessions.

shop.title: Shop
shop.subtitle: Available June 2 only — in the partner area. Card payment only, no cash. Proceeds go to the Experts Live Scholarship.
shop.handmade: All items are exclusively designed by MVP Koos Goossens — limited edition, made with passion and craftsmanship for the Experts Live community.

studiebeurs.heading: Experts Live Scholarship — nominate talent
studiebeurs.body1: With every purchase you nominate someone for the €5,000 Experts Live Scholarship: a Microsoft certification package (exams, study material, training) to be used within 12 months.
studiebeurs.body2: More purchases = more nominations. Self-nomination is allowed. The winner is announced via LinkedIn within 30 days after the event.

auction.closedThanks: Auction closed — thanks for joining in

publicTransport.intro: From the Nieuwegein Stadscentrum tram stop:

car.heading: By car
car.shuttle: Free shuttle bus every ~15 min between the venue and Sportpark Galecop parking

farewell.heading: On your way out
farewell.body: There's a poffertjes (mini Dutch pancakes) stand at the exit — grab some for the road on us.

questions.title: Questions?
questions.body: Ask one of the volunteers (recognizable by their Experts Live clothing) or visit the registration desk.
questions.emergency: Medical emergency: report at the desk or call 112.

access.title: Accessibility
access.halls: All halls are accessible (except the Entresol I common area). For halls 3–10, take the lift on the left side of the building.
access.captions: Live captions are provided in Event Hall I & II and Grand Hall.
access.feeding: A nursing room is located on the first floor, next to the Grand Hall balcony entrance.
access.help: Need assistance? Let us know at the registration desk.

radio.title: Experts Live Radio
radio.body: Live radio straight from the NBC: interviews with speakers and sponsors, session highlights, event updates and music in between. Tune in on both June 1 and 2.
